description: The 42nd Contracting Squadron at Maxwell Air Force Base (AFB), Alabama intends to award a sole source, firm fixed price (FFP) contract to Advantor Systems II, LLC. 12612 Challenger Parkway, Suite 300, 300 Orlando, Florida 32826 for the purchase and installation of an Intruder Detection System (IDS) duress alarm system in accordance with the attached Draft Statement of Work. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 334290 with a size standard of 800 employees.
